scenarios.name: retiree, qualified retirement income exempt
scenarios.source: MS Code 27-7-15(4)(l): retirement allowances, pensions, annuities, or optional retirement allowances paid by a private retirement system or plan of which the recipient was a member during employment are excluded from gross income. ((4)(j) is combat-zone hazardous-duty pay for Armed Forces members and does not apply here; (4)(k) covers government retirement systems, not this private pension/IRA household.)
